source.note: From AMUPedia's Google Drive (amupedia2021): '2nd Year' is Mechanical Engineering semesters 3-4 (2021-22) with mid/end-sem papers; 'semester 3' is the AI/Computer branch 3rd semester (AIC2020, AIC2040, AIC2060, AIC2070, ELA2110, AMS2610, EZH2910).

meta.title: Sem-End 2021-22 · Machine Design-I (MEC-2130)
meta.summary: Scanned 2021-22 end-semester paper for Machine Design-I (MEC-2130) with a student's handwritten working over the questions, across 11 pages.

meta.title: Sem-End 2021-22 · Kinematics of Machines (MEC2120)
meta.summary: End-semester 2021-22 paper for Kinematics of Machines: Grubler's criterion, degrees of freedom, inversions, straight-line mechanisms and related problems.

meta.title: Impedance Loading and Matching
meta.summary: Slides on impedance loading and matching, including the loading effect of a recorder on a transducer element and the voltage-divider relation.

meta.title: Classification of Instruments
meta.summary: Slides classifying instruments by physical effect, type of operation, representation, energy requirement, proximity and processing (dumb vs intelligent).

meta.title: Data Presentation Element
meta.summary: Slides on the data presentation element of a measurement system and the display/recording stages that present the measured value.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · Probability distributions
meta.summary: Handwritten class notes (January 2022) on probability density functions — continuous, joint, marginal and conditional — and distribution mean and variance.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · Probability
meta.summary: Handwritten class notes (November 2021) opening Unit 1 on probability, with a worked example on the probability of an event.

meta.title: Transducers
meta.summary: Slide deck on transducers and strain gauges: resistive metal and semiconductor gauges, stress/strain relations and transducer elements.

meta.title: Unit 3 notes · Vector Differentiation
meta.summary: Handwritten notes on scalar and vector fields, gradient, its direction and magnitude, with worked examples.

meta.title: Unit 3 notes · Vector Integration
meta.summary: Handwritten notes on line integrals of vector fields, tangential components and the start of vector integration methods.

meta.title: Unit 2 notes · Zeros and Singularities
meta.summary: Handwritten notes defining zeros of analytic functions and their order, singular points, with worked examples.

meta.title: Gears · Terminology and Law of Gearing
meta.summary: Slide deck listing gear terms (pitch, addendum, module, pressure angle, path of contact) and the law of gearing.

meta.title: Gears · Solved Problems
meta.summary: Two worked numerical problems on path of contact, arc of contact, addendum and angle of action of involute gears.

meta.title: Gears · Interference and Minimum Number of Teeth
meta.summary: Slides on interference and undercutting, maximum path/arc of contact to avoid it, and the minimum number of teeth needed.

meta.title: Gear Trains · Types of Gear Trains
meta.summary: Definition and classification of gear trains into simple, compound, reverted and epicyclic trains, with simple and compound train velocity-ratio slides.

meta.title: Gear Trains · Epicyclic Gear Trains
meta.summary: Construction, relative-velocity reasoning and applications of epicyclic gear trains, with tabular-method examples.

meta.title: Home Assignment 2021-22 · Gears and Gear Trains
meta.summary: Five-problem home assignment on law of gearing, interference and minimum teeth, path of contact, reverted and epicyclic gear trains.

meta.title: Lectures 1–3 · Friction Wheels and Gears: Introduction
meta.summary: Opening lectures of the gears chapter: friction-wheel drives and slip, why teeth are cut, and advantages and disadvantages of gears.

meta.title: Mid-Sem 2020-21 · Machine Design I (EMEC2130)
meta.summary: B.E. sessional paper of 2020-21: bolted wall-bracket and machine-element design questions, maximum marks 30 in one hour.

meta.title: Lecture slides · Unit 3 Part 3 · Analysis of Bolted Joints
meta.summary: Analysis of bolted joints: bolt in tension, eccentrically loaded bolted joints in shear, and eccentric load perpendicular to the bolt axis.

meta.title: Lecture slides · Mechanics of Metal Cutting
meta.summary: Metal-cutting mechanics for machine tools: cutting tool geometry, chip formation and forces, based on P.N. Rao's Manufacturing Technology Vol. 2.

meta.title: Lecture slides · Mechanization of Machine Tools
meta.summary: Degrees of freedom and mechanization of machine tools, leading into jigs and fixtures for machining.

meta.title: Lecture slides · Heat Treatment of Steel
meta.summary: Heat treatment of steel: the iron-carbon phase diagram, phases and the effect of heating and cooling on steel structure.

meta.title: Class notes · Mechanical Properties and Classification of Materials
meta.summary: Handwritten notes on mechanical properties of engineering materials (strength, toughness, hardness, ductility) and the classification into ferrous and non-ferrous metals.

meta.summary: Handwritten notes on alloying elements, tool and high-speed steels, and non-ferrous metals and alloys with their properties and uses.

meta.summary: Slide deck (course MEC2110) on thin-walled cylinders: hoop and longitudinal stresses, and the three principal strains under internal pressure.

meta.summary: Slide deck on strengthening thin-walled tubes by winding wire under tension: need, hoop-stress reduction and design relations.

meta.title: Lecture 6 · Thick Walled Pressure Vessels
meta.summary: Slide deck on thick cylinders: applications, equilibrium equations and stress distribution in thick-walled pressure vessels.

meta.summary: Handwritten notes (4 Feb 2022) deriving normal and shear strain components in three dimensions from the displacement field.

meta.summary: Handwritten notes (11 Feb 2022) distinguishing rigid-body motion from deformation and introducing engineering and tensorial strain tensors.

meta.title: Notes · Beam deflection by double integration
meta.summary: Handwritten notes (11 Mar 2022) working a simply supported beam deflection by the double-integration method with boundary conditions.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · Stress vector, Cauchy relation and Hooke's law
meta.summary: Handwritten notes (17 Dec 2021) on the traction/stress vector, the Cauchy stress relation and generalized Hooke's law, with a worked plane-stress problem.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · Compliance and stiffness matrices
meta.summary: Handwritten notes (18 Feb 2022) on strain–stress compliance and stiffness matrices and the isotropic material matrix with shear modulus.

meta.summary: Handwritten notes on the traction (stress) vector on a plane, stress components on a differential element and the equilibrium argument behind them.
